candidates.name: Tidewater Stalls & Specialties, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Has a 'Bathroom Partition Installation' service page ('We install bathroom partitions from leading manufacturers including Bobrick, Bradley, and Hadrian', floor-mounted, ceiling-hung and floor-to-ceiling). Its homepage testimonials describe restroom partition and toilet compartment installs. It has an installation team lead.
candidates.reason: A Division 10 specialist based in Virginia Beach that installs commercial bathroom partitions and has service-area pages for Norfolk, Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, Hampton, Newport News and Suffolk. It is also an authorized distributor that supplies partitions, so it is a buy-around risk.
red_flags: Distributor that supplies and sells partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Mainly serves general contractors and construction managers

candidates.name: Virginia Storage Systems, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Its homepage features a project where it 'installed 21 toilet stalls' (solid-core phenolic) at a Williamsburg theme park. Its toilet partitions page offers partitions with a one-year guarantee on parts, material and workmanship, and says its installers keep ADA training current.
candidates.reason: Based in Chesapeake, it sells and installs toilet partitions 'anywhere in Hampton Roads' for commercial and industrial clients. It also sells partitions itself (buy-around risk), and its website hasn't been updated since 2014.
red_flags: Website copyright is 2014, so it may be stale; check the business is still active
No general company email; only staff-name emails are on the site
